result.summary: The page mostly looks like a standard food delivery home screen, but there are a few visual defects: the bottom navigation bar appears broken with a stray horizontal line overlapping two icons, a truncated/empty filter chip at the right edge, and truncated restaurant name text in the horizontal carousel.

issues.description: In the bottom navigation bar, a long horizontal black line/bar stretches between the search icon and the receipt/orders icon, overlapping both. This looks like a rendering artifact or misplaced divider rather than an intentional element, making the middle nav items look struck-through and broken.
issues.suggestion: Remove or reposition the stray line element; each nav icon should render cleanly without overlapping graphics.

issues.description: Bottom navigation icons appear vertically clipped by the bottom edge of the screen (home icon and profile icon are partially cut off), suggesting the nav bar height or safe-area inset is incorrect.
issues.suggestion: Add proper bottom safe-area padding / increase nav bar height so all icons are fully visible.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol...' in the 'Fastest near you' carousel is truncated without an ellipsis, appearing cut off mid-word.
issues.suggestion: Apply text truncation with an ellipsis or wrap the name to a second line so partially cut text doesn't look broken.

issues.description: The last filter chip at the top right edge is cut off and shows no visible label, appearing as an empty pill fragment.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the horizontal chip list peeks a meaningful portion of the next chip (including some label text) or add a fade/scroll indicator so it reads as scrollable rather than broken.

issues.description: Bottom navigation icons have no text labels, and the inactive icons are low-contrast gray, which reduces clarity of navigation destinations.
issues.suggestion: Add short text labels under each nav icon and ensure inactive states meet contrast guidelines.
